description:
Calculate the shortest delivery route from the Warehouse to the Customer using the provided road network.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the road network layer from '/home/ga/GIS_Data/road_network.geojson'.
3. Load the stops layer from '/home/ga/GIS_Data/logistics_stops.geojson' (contains Warehouse and Customer points).
4. Open the Processing Toolbox (Ctrl+Alt+T) and search for 'Shortest path (point to point)'.
5. Configure the tool:
   - Vector network representing graph: 'road_network'
   - Path type to calculate: Shortest (distance)
   - Start point: Select the 'Warehouse' point location (South-West corner).
   - End point: Select the 'Customer' point location (North-East corner).
6. Run the tool.
7. Save the resulting route (Shortest path layer) as a GeoJSON file to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/delivery_route.geojson'.
